summary: Adds a bounded offline review protocol, deterministic source targets, and read-only feedback binding for agent-to-human report handoff.

evidence.sourceGrammar: Version-1 review JSON is a strict closed record with bounded response unions; compile-time targets come only from parsed container directives and ordinary Markdown blocks, with authored ranges and optional explicit section identity.
evidence.executionCapabilities: The current unit adds only inert target metadata, canonical parsing and serialization, and read-only source binding; it cannot rewrite Markdown, execute feedback, register callbacks, publish output, or grant review authority.
evidence.confinement: Review inspection first prepares the report source root, then resolves the relative review path through the existing URI-normalized lexical and canonical symlink confinement boundary before reading one ordinary bounded file.
evidence.offlineBehavior: Build, embedded target discovery, review parsing, and source binding use local source files and package code only; both output formats retain normal file URL behavior and the review command starts no listener or network request.
evidence.deterministicSerialization: Canonical serialization omits clocks and random values, sorts response and checklist identities, normalizes human text to Unicode NFC, and is byte-equal for equivalent state; report revision also binds the versioned canonical target projection.
evidence.cspAndRuntime: The target manifest is React-escaped text inside an inert template element and adds no script, style, URL, CSP source, or browser listener; package runtime and stylesheet bytes remain unchanged in this unit.
evidence.accessibility: Normal semantic elements retain their existing roles, names, focus behavior, and visible content; inert data-review-target attributes and the hidden template add no focusable or accessibility-tree control in this unit.
evidence.byteAndPerformanceBudgets: The parity fixture adds 3,619 serialized HTML bytes in either format while runtime and stylesheet stay unchanged; target collection is one bounded AST pass capped at 500 targets and the embedded manifest fails above 750,000 bytes.
evidence.packageDependenciesAndLicenses: No package or browser dependency is added; implementation uses existing Node crypto/filesystem APIs, unified traversal, React escaping, and the MIT-licensed package code already distributed by the project.
evidence.compatibility: Existing Markdown, build, validate, inspect, output contentHash, single-file and directory contracts remain supported; review is an additive CLI and ESM surface, unsupported schema versions fail explicitly, and cross-file binding cannot impersonate changed content in a still-present source file.
